details.description: Nemotron 3 Ultra is NVIDIA's largest Nemotron 3 model, a 550-billion-parameter hybrid Mamba-2/Transformer Mixture-of-Experts language model with 55 billion parameters active per token, released June 4, 2026. NVIDIA built it for agentic reasoning, coding, planning, tool calling and long-context analysis, and released it under its OpenMDW-1.1 license for commercial and non-commercial use. NVIDIA reports it leads open models on accuracy and efficiency for agentic RTL (hardware-description-language) coding.
advantages: Scores 69.7 on SWE-Bench Verified and 87.9 on GPQA (no tools), per NVIDIA's model card.
Scores 94.0 on RULER at 1M-token context and 82.3 on IFBench (prompt), per NVIDIA's model card.

Achieved a 97.1% average pass rate across nine CVDP hardware-coding categories when paired with NVIDIA's ACE-RTL agent, ahead of GLM 5.2 (92.1%) and Kimi K2.6 (95.2%), per an NVIDIA developer blog post.
Uses a hybrid Mamba-2 + Mixture-of-Experts + Attention architecture with multi-token prediction and latent expert routing, keeping only 55B of its 550B parameters active per token.
disadvantages: Text-only: no image, audio or video input or output, per NVIDIA's model card.
Newly released (June 2026), so independent third-party benchmarking beyond NVIDIA's own reported figures is limited so far.
use_cases: Long-context agentic reasoning and multi-step task planning
Software engineering and coding agents, including RTL (hardware description language) coding
Tool calling and complex agent orchestration
High-accuracy retrieval-augmented generation over long documents

sources.title: How Full-Stack NIM Optimizations Deliver 2.5x More Users on Nemotron 3 Ultra
NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra Leads Open Models on Accuracy and Efficiency in Agentic RTL Coding

notes: Catalog's max_input_tokens (512,288) is lower than what NVIDIA states: the model card advertises up to 1M tokens (1,048,576) of context, while an NVIDIA NIM performance blog describes a 256K native context; kept the catalog's 512,288 figure per instructions rather than restating a different number. Modality (text-only) and empty deprecation_date match NVIDIA's current model card, which shows no deprecation notice as of the research date.
